A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
fermentation of wheat dough prior to baking is an effective way of lowering the GI in wheat bread, but the effect is not as pronounced in other cereal products.
lactic acid added to wheat bread prior to baking reduces the rate of starch degradation, and thus the glycaemic responses, by 15 20%.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the addition of lactic to bread, prior to baking, can be used to reduce the GI of bread and other wheat based cereal products.
lactic acid is a food mechanism that may be useful for the development of foods with a lowered GI.
